items.summary: HubSpot announced a major leadership reshuffle, with co founder Brian Halligan returning as CEO and Adobe executive Karen Burgess set to replace retiring CFO Kate Bueker in February 2027, while Bueker stays on as an adviser through the end of 2027. items.title: Adobe’s Sam Garfield: AI has Sped Up Creative, But Organizations Haven’t Kept Pace
items.summary: RANCHO PALOS VERDES, CALIF. — Creative ideation that once took weeks now takes days, and sometimes hours. Versioning an asset across channels, formats, and aspect ratios has sped up just as much. The slowdown has moved somewhere else.
